author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Shower subfloor tips…I use Safe’n’Sound inside the joist bays. Then I apply Great Stuff Construction adhesive to the joists and fasten my 3/4” plywood with 2” screws. This reduces sound from pipes and properly preps the shower for the next steps. Learn more tips with me at my website homerepairtutor.com 🔥#showerremodel #bathroomproject #hometips #homerepairtutor
